claim_draft: A system for monitoring cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) shunt function in a patient, comprising: an implantable wireless pressure sensor configured for deployment adjacent to an endovascular CSF shunt positioned between a subarachnoid space and a dural venous sinus of the patient; a transmitter configured to wirelessly transmit pressure data from the sensor to an external receiver; and a receiver configured to process the pressure data to determine shunt patency and CSF flow adequacy.
